tasks.label: Compilar (gcc + Allegro5)
tasks.command: export PATH=/mingw64/bin:$PATH; mkdir -p build && gcc -g -Wall -Wextra -Iinclude $(pkg-config --cflags allegro-5 allegro_image-5 allegro_font-5 allegro_ttf-5 allegro_audio-5 allegro_acodec-5 allegro_primitives-5 allegro_dialog-5) src/main.c src/cavaleiro.c src/inimigo.c src/jogo.c src/recursos.c -o build/JornadaDoCavaleiro.exe $(pkg-config --libs allegro_main-5 allegro-5 allegro_image-5 allegro_font-5 allegro_ttf-5 allegro_audio-5 allegro_acodec-5 allegro_primitives-5 allegro_dialog-5)
